# FCT Vinh Thinh Joint Stock Company — Vietnamese Spices & Highland Tea Exporter

> Official B2B export portal (`https://agri.fct.vn`) of **FCT Vinh Thinh Joint Stock Company** (`Công Ty Cổ Phần FCT Vĩnh Thịnh`), a direct manufacturer, processor, and bulk exporter of Vietnamese Cassia Cinnamon, Sliced Cinnamon Twigs (`Gui Zhi`), Cinnamon Leaves, Lang Son Star Anise, and Highland Whole-Leaf Green & Black Tea. Shipping globally via **Hai Phong Port, Vietnam** with a monthly supply capacity of **up to 500 Metric Tons (MT)**.

## Company & Export Profile
- **Legal Name**: FCT Vinh Thinh Joint Stock Company (`Công Ty Cổ Phần FCT Vĩnh Thịnh`)
- **Official Website**: https://agri.fct.vn
- **Full AI Sourcing Dossier**: https://agri.fct.vn/llms-full.txt
- **Head Office**: Star Building, 15B Nguyen Canh Di St, Dinh Cong Ward, Hoang Mai Dist, Hanoi, Vietnam
- **Sourcing & Processing Regions**: Yen Bai, Quang Nam, Lang Son, and Northern Vietnam Highland Tea Estates
- **Main Port of Loading**: Hai Phong Port, Vietnam (`VNHPH`)
- **Monthly Supply Capacity**: Up to 500 MT / Month
- **Incoterms Supported**: FOB Hai Phong, CIF, CFR (20GP, 40GP, 40HC containers via K-LINE, ONE, Evergreen, Maersk, COSCO)
- **Payment Terms**: T/T (Telegraphic Transfer) or Irrevocable L/C at sight
- **Standard Export Documentation**: Certificate of Origin (C/O Form B, D, E, AI, EUR.1, CPTPP, RCEP), Phytosanitary Certificate, Fumigation Certificate, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading (B/L), and optional independent third-party inspection (SGS / Vinacontrol)
- **Export Markets Served**: China, Taiwan, India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Middle East, EU (Germany, Netherlands, France, UK), USA, Japan, South Korea, ASEAN

## Export Product Catalog & Specifications
- [Vietnamese Cassia Cinnamon (HS 0906.11 / 0906.19 / 0906.20)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon.html): Yen Bai & Quang Nam cassia bark — Cigarette/Cigar sticks (8–45 cm), tube/rolled bark, split cassia, broken cassia, and pure fine powder (80–120 mesh). Essential oil 2.0%–4.5%+, moisture <= 13.5%, compressed bales (20–25 kg) or 10–25 kg export cartons. MOQ: 1,000 kg (1 MT).
- [Vietnamese Star Anise — Illicium verum (HS 0909.61)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/star-anise.html): Authentic Lang Son highland Spring & Autumn harvest star anise. Whole 8-pointed pods (>80% intact), moisture <= 12.5%–13.0%, essential oil >= 8%–10%, sun-dried or steam-processed. Packed in 5 kg / 10 kg / 20 kg FCT branded export cartons. MOQ: 500 kg.
- [Cinnamon Branches & Diagonal-Sliced Twigs / Gui Zhi (HS 0906.19)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon-branches.html): Natural whole cinnamon branches, cut branch segments (`桂枝丁`), and uniform diagonal-sliced cinnamon twigs (`桂枝片`) for culinary, herbal, and decorative wholesale. Packed in PP woven export bags. MOQ: 100–1,000 kg.
- [Dried Vietnamese Cinnamon Leaves (HS 0906.19 / 1211.90)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/cinnamon-leaves.html): Freshly harvested and shade-dried highland cinnamon leaves retaining high natural volatile oil for essential oil distillation, extraction, and herbal tea blending. MOQ: 500 kg.
- [Vietnamese Highland Whole-Leaf Green Tea (HS 0902.10 / 0902.20)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/green-tea.html): Northern Vietnam highland green tea in OP (Orange Pekoe whole curled leaf), Pekoe/TH101, and PS/BPS fannings. Moisture <= 7.5%–8.0%, water extract >= 32%–36%, total ash 4.0%–6.5%. PE-lined 20–25 kg multi-wall kraft sacks or 30–45 kg PP bags. 10–12 MT / 20FCL · 20–24 MT / 40HC. MOQ: 500 kg.
- [Vietnamese Highland Whole-Leaf Black Tea (HS 0902.30 / 0902.40)](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products/black-tea.html): Fully oxidized (90%–100%) highland black tea in Orthodox OP/FBOP (golden tips), Pekoe/PS/BPS, and CTC (BP1, PF1, PD granular). Amber-red liquor, moisture <= 7.5%–8.0%, water extract >= 32%–38%. 20–25 kg kraft or 25–40 kg PP/PE bags. 10–13 MT / 20FCL · 21–25 MT / 40HC. MOQ: 500 kg.
- [Full Export Catalog Overview](https://agri.fct.vn/pages/products.html): Complete B2B product comparison, container loading gallery, and factory processing videos.
